statement: 164 core/cutting samples selected from six wells; important intervals and palynologically suitable shale/siltstone; infill cuttings between cores and in non-cored sections; intervals depend on material availability.
qualification: Declared study inventory, not random basin sampling or continuous coverage.

statement: Core/cutting cleaning under running water; some cores split; cuttings washed through 1.7/0.7 mm sieves; 20 g per sample; HCl/HF; 10 micrometre screen; variable 5-10 min nitric-acid oxidation; three-four palynological slides and two kerogen slides.
qualification: Cleaning intended to remove drilling mud/surface contamination; does not establish absence of downhole caving or uniform recovery.

statement: Count all specimens on first palynological slide and scan the second; generally log one slide and scan other slides for rare palynomorphs. Separate 200 organic-particle counts are for palynofacies.
qualification: Do not represent 200 as a fixed spore search or treat slide/preparation subsamples as independent material.

statement: StrataBug generates stratigraphical ranges, presence, absence and abundance for palynomorphs in each well, and palynofacies charts.
qualification: A chart-reporting rule can be proposed; sample linkage and nonreporting versus observed non-detection still need explicit adjudication.

statement: Methods state 164 samples/six wells; palynostratigraphy introduction states 167 samples/five wells; conclusion states 167 samples.
qualification: Appendix1 independently enumerates164; prose discrepancy does not create three extra samples.

statement: Preparation prose names zinc chloride heavy liquid (ZnCl; S.G.1.95); flowchart labels heavy mineral separation ZnBr.
qualification: Preserve conflicting names; do not assert a single verified reagent.
